_comment: v1.13.2 follow-up - subsection markers for the twelve Bellum Alexandrinum excerpts, which shipped without them. Boundaries from the Library of Digital Latin Texts edition (ed. Cynthia Damon et al., CC BY-SA 4.0), split into tools/.cache/sections/ldlt-balex.<N>.json by tools/fetch_sections_ldlt.js. The same edition independently reproduces the five boundaries of BA 1 that were hand-read from PHI at launch. English and Italian anchors written by hand, one per section. Two overrides, both for the same reason: the edition spells the city Alexandria where the Latin Library has Alexandrea, and the matcher starts from three words.
